headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 17, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets continued their winning streak, dominating the Cincinnati Reds 9-1 behind Nolan McLean's strong performance on the mound. In other action, the Kansas City Royals took down the Washington Nationals 6-2, with Luinder Avila earning the win and Carter Jensen leading the offense with a 4-hit performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Kansas City Royals left-handed pitcher Cole Ragans, who has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left elbow impingement. Atlanta Braves right-handed pitcher Spencer Strider has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation, while Cleveland Guardians right fielder Chase DeLauter has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right side rib fracture.

The Seattle Mariners made a roster move, trading right-handed pitcher Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays also made a trade, sending catcher Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Reds 9-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-1 victory. Nolan McLean led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Nationals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a 6-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Luinder Avila earning the win after pitching 5.2 innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 4-hit performance, including a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Phillies 12-4**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 12-4 victory. Kyle Stowers led the Marlins' offense with a 4-hit, 2-home run performance, driving in 5 runs.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Braves 7-2**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a 7-2 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Jung Hoo Lee leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Robbie Ray earned the win, pitching 6.1 innings with eight strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Pitcher Sidelined with Injury**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals left-handed pitcher Cole Ragans has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left elbow impingement. This move comes as an update to his status.

top_news.title: **Mariners Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash on June 17, 2026.
